episode1.title: Standing on the Summit of Jirisan Cheonwangbong
episode1.body: At 4AM, I pushed through the cold winds of Jangteomok Shelter to reach the summit of Cheonwangbong. The joy of sipping warm tea with club members while watching the clouds turn crimson was beyond anything else.
episode1.fullContent:
At 4AM, I pushed through the cold winds of Jangteomok Shelter to reach the summit of Cheonwangbong. The joy of sipping warm tea with club members while watching the clouds turn crimson was beyond anything else.

The rock ridge section was thrilling, but we helped each other and successfully reached the summit.

episode2.title: Starlight and Memories at Jangteomok Shelter
episode2.body: The warmth we shared at Jangteomok Shelter... Even the cold night wind of Jirisan melted away before a cup of warm tea and the laughter of our club members.
episode2.fullContent: The warmth we shared at Jangteomok Shelter... Preserving memories with photos from the shared drive.
